# Kingdom of Malwa

Kingdom of Malwa may refer to:
* Kingdom of Malwa (350–625), a kingdom in Ancient India ruled by the Aulikaras and Kalachuris of Mahishmati
* Kingdom of Malwa (947–1304), a kingdom in Early Mediaeval India ruled by the Paramaras
* Sultanate of Malwa (1401–1562), a kingdom in Late Mediaeval India ruled by the Ghurids and Khaljis
